references.text: The Spirit of the Lord came upon Othniel, and he became a judge in Israel. This shows the same pattern where the Spirit of the Lord equips judges for mighty deeds.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Gideon and gave him strength to lead Israel. The same expression is used regarding the Spirit's powerful intervention.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, which parallels how the Spirit equips judges for battle.
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson. This is the first time the Spirit acts in Samson's life, before the powerful empowerment in this verse.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson when he killed the lion. The same expression and the same person as in this verse.
The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon Samson, and he killed a thousand men. Once again, the Spirit equips Samson with supernatural strength.
The Spirit of God came upon Saul, and he prophesied. Shows how the Spirit came upon chosen leaders in Israel.
The Spirit of God came upon Saul, and his anger was kindled. A parallel to both the coming of the Spirit and the anger that Samson experienced.
